name: TheraThink
short_description: Outsourced insurance billing for mental-health clinicians: benefits checks, claim filing and denial follow-up, charged as a share of paid claims.
long_description: TheraThink is a billing service for therapists and psychiatric clinicians rather than software you run yourself. It checks benefits, files claims daily, processes EOBs and ERAs, follows up on denials, and offers credentialing. It charges a percentage of the allowed amount on paid claims only, plus a small monthly claims-processing fee passed through at cost from its clearinghouse, Office Ally. There is no per-claim, sign-up or annual fee; contracts are month-to-month with a free 30-day trial. The percentage is quoted rather than published. Covers EAP, Medicare, Medicaid and TRICARE billing.
one_liner: Hand insurance billing to a team that only gets paid when you do.
best_for: Solo therapists who want insurance billing entirely off their plate
Clinicians who prefer paying only on paid claims over a monthly subscription
Newly in-network clinicians who also want credentialing help
Practices billing EAP, Medicare, Medicaid or TRICARE alongside commercial plans
not_for: High-fee psychiatry practices, where a percentage of collections can exceed software costs
Clinicians who want published, fixed pricing before talking to sales
Practices that want billing to stay inside their own EHR account
